blocks.text: Historia imeandikwa!
Green Acres Schools imeweka historia kwa kuwa shule ya kwanza jijini Dar es Salaam kuzindua rasmi Klabu ya Uhamiaji.
Uzinduzi huo uliongozwa na Mkuu wa Wilaya ya Kinondoni, Mhe. Saad Mtambule, ukiweka msisitizo katika kuwajenga vijana wenye uzalendo, maadili, uelewa wa sheria na uwajibikaji kwa Taifa.
Tunajivunia kushirikiana na Ofisi ya Mkuu wa Wilaya ya Kinondoni, Jeshi la Uhamiaji na viongozi mbalimbali wa Serikali katika kuandaa kizazi cha viongozi wa kesho.
Tazama baadhi ya matukio ya siku hii ya kihistoria.

title: Green Acres Schools Honored for Compassionate Contribution at “Upendo wa Yatima kwa Mama” Event
excerpt: We were honored to take part in the “Upendo wa Yatima kwa Mama” event organized by the Sisi na Mama Foundation. Through this initiative, Green Acres Schools have successfully committed to fully sponsor four students (100%) starting from 2026, giving them the o

blocks.text: We were honored to take part in the “Upendo wa Yatima kwa Mama” event organized by the Sisi na Mama Foundation. Through this initiative, Green Acres Schools have successfully committed to fully sponsor four students (100%) starting from 2026, giving them the opportunity to pursue both primary and secondary education in our Dar es Salaam campuses.

During the event, we also received a Honorary Award in recognition of our acts of compassion. The award was presented by Hon. Abdallah Ulega, Minister for Works, on behalf of Hon. President Dr. Samia Suluhu Hassan, and was received by Green Acres Executive Director, Mrs. Jacklyne Rushaigo.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to the Government of the United Republic of Tanzania and the Sisi na Mama Foundation for valuing and recognizing our contribution to nation-building through education.

For 25 years, Green Acres Schools have remained dedicated to providing quality education that nurtures knowledge, discipline, and strong moral values in our learners across our campuses in Dar es Salaam and Kagera.
We remain steadfast in our mission to ensure that every child has the opportunity to learn and achieve their dreams.

title: Green Acres Career Day, August 2025: Inspiring Dreams, Shaping Futures
excerpt: Career Day at Green Acres School, August 2025 was a celebration of dreams, possibilities, and inspiration! From the medical field to the arts, from business to sports, our students explored a variety of professions through engaging talks and live demonstratio

blocks.text: Career Day at Green Acres School, August 2025 was a celebration of dreams, possibilities, and inspiration! From the medical field to the arts, from business to sports, our students explored a variety of professions through engaging talks and live demonstrations.

This unique event gave learners the confidence to envision their future and the motivation to work hard towards it. With plenty of fun, interaction, and exploration, Career Day proved once again that at Green Acres, the sky is the limit!

title: Green Acres Schools 25 Years Anniversary
excerpt: To everyone who showed up, dressed up, pledged, gave, danced, cheered, and stood with us; thank you. You’ve written yourselves into the legacy of Green Acres.

blocks.text: The 25th Anniversary Fundraising Dinner was nothing short of extraordinary. A perfect blend of elegance, laughter, purpose, and powerful connections.
To everyone who showed up, dressed up, pledged, gave, danced, cheered, and stood with us; thank you. You’ve written yourselves into the legacy of Green Acres.
Here’s to 25 years of impact, and to the future we’re building together.
